name: a checklist confirms the mode before a toggle locks in
looks: Beside a draft post card, a short checklist ticks off one item at a time ("sounds human", "follows the rules", "helps first"), then a two-way mode pill (one option muted, one bold) gets clicked by a cursor and locks to the chosen side as an approve button fills solid.
build: command-chip-cycle for the mode pill (the two options swap emphasis on a quick scale/opacity change as the cursor clicks); each checklist line's check mark pops in on back.out a beat apart ahead of it.
sound: A tick per checklist item, a click on the toggle, a confirming chime on approve.
prompt: Tick through a short checklist of reassurances one line at a time beside a draft output. End on a two-way mode toggle that a cursor clicks to lock into the bolder option, followed by an approve button filling solid. Use it to show a human reviewing before a system is trusted to run on its own.
